issue.title: I always get editor v2 but set v1 in the settings

license.name: GNU Affero General Public License v3.0

issue.body:
**Describe the bug**
When I edit an article or create a new one, it gets opened in the v2 editor, but I want all to be opened in the v1 editor as I said in my settings.

**Expected behavior**
I would prefer all articles to be editable with v1

**Desktop (please complete the following information):**

- OS: Windows 7
- Browser: Firefox
- Version: 67.0b19 (64-Bit)

This v2 editor will be the death of me. It already deleted my content once and just now it said "Publishing" when I hit save, but I didn't want to publish. It didn't publish, but it said it would and I almost got a heart attack.
